title: LaTeX Table OS Style Parity
summary: Added `\semio@spacing@single` padding above and below table row text: `\noalign{\vskip\semio@spacing@single}` before each `\SemioTableRow` (clears the divider above) and `\\[\semio@spacing@single]` before the row-ending `\hline`. Header cells now use matching `\vspace{\semio@spacing@single}` top and bottom inside `\semio@table@header@cell`. Verified zwischenbericht light/dark builds still render table content.
